text: Mira founded the Lumen observatory. The observatory is in Alder Bay.
The Lumen observatory opened in 2018. Its first director was Ivo.
Ivo studied optics at Northbridge College. Northbridge College is in Eastmere.
Mira moved from Alder Bay to Westhaven in 2020. She still works for Lumen.
The Cedar expedition departed in March 2021. Its leader was Tavi.
Tavi joined the Lumen observatory in 2019 as a marine sensor engineer.
The Cedar expedition returned in October 2021. Its samples were stored in Westhaven.
The Alder Bay archive acquired the Cedar logbook in 2022.
Rin became the Lumen director in 2023, succeeding Ivo.
Rin previously directed the Helix laboratory in Southpoint.
The Helix laboratory studies wave dynamics. Its main instrument is the Arc scanner.
The Arc scanner was designed by Sena and first calibrated in 2017.
Sena teaches at Northbridge College. Her public notes describe optical calibration.
The Westhaven repository opened in 2016 and stores marine samples.
Aster is a library in Eastmere. It holds the printed Northbridge course catalogue.
The Lumen public archive lists directors and expeditions but records no private telephone numbers.
